violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. No employee certified through an approved food safety management course was present at the time of inspection. Establishment must have employee(s) register in, and successfully complete, an approved course in food safety management. New Violation. Correct By: 11/23/2026

Working containers of dry ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/26/2026

The presence of insects is not controlled as evidenced by small flies observed in the prep kitchen and at the counter. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Pest control is to be contacted to assess the issue and treat as needed. New Violation. Correct By: 10/26/2026
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Utensils must be stored in a clean, dry location. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/26/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of black residue and other debris. Ice machine must remain clean to sight and touch. Ice machine must be cleaned. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026

The pre-flush spray hose at the 3-bay sink is hanging below the flood rim. A plumbing system shall be installed to prevent backflow of a liquid or gas contaminant into the water supply by providing an air gap or installing an approved backflow prevention device. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/26/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the sanitizer bucket was 0 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200 - 400 ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/03/2025

The pre-flush spray hose at the 3-bay sink is hanging below the flood rim. A plumbing system shall be installed to prevent backflow of a liquid or gas contaminant into the water supply by providing an air gap or installing an approved backflow prevention device. New Violation. Correct By: 11/03/2025

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the sanitizer bucket was observed at 0 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200 - 300 ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/06/2024
